items.title: Accessibility score below 90
items.symptom: Lighthouse Accessibility under 90, or reviewer cites keyboard / contrast / labels.
items.check: Run the Accessibility scorecard section and re-test with keyboard-only navigation on product, cart, and menu.

items.title: Lighthouse Performance below 60
items.symptom: Mobile or desktop Performance under 60 on realistic demo content.
items.check: Confirm images use Shopify CDN + lazy loading, defer non-critical JS, and re-run Lighthouse on the demo store — not localhost.

items.title: Missing @app blocks
items.symptom: Rejection mentions app blocks missing on main product / featured product sections.
items.check: Ensure product and featured product sections include an @app block; verify in the theme editor that apps can be added.

items.title: Placeholder or Lorem Ipsum content
items.symptom: Demo store still shows filler copy, stock onboarding text, or empty collections.
items.check: Replace every placeholder string; use real products/photos; walk the demo as a shopper.

items.title: Theme looks like a reskin
items.symptom: Reviewer says the experience is too close to Dawn, Horizon, or another Theme Store listing.
items.check: Compare header, product card, collection, and cart against 3–4 Theme Store themes. Uniqueness must be structural, not only colors.

items.title: Built on Dawn or Horizon
items.symptom: Submission based on Dawn/Horizon instead of Skeleton Theme or original code.
items.check: Confirm scaffold origin. New submissions must start from Skeleton Theme or fully original code.

items.title: SCSS or pre-minified assets shipped
items.symptom: Zip contains .scss files or pre-minified CSS/JS Shopify disallows.
items.check: Compile to plain CSS; remove .scss; leave minification to Shopify except allowed exceptions.

items.title: Settings use developer jargon
items.symptom: Theme editor labels confuse merchants or ignore Shopify terminology.
items.check: Rewrite setting labels in merchant language; group logically; match official font/color setting patterns.

items.title: Required templates or features missing
items.symptom: Missing templates, gift cards, search, selling plans, or other required features.
items.check: Walk the Required Features and Templates scorecard sections item by item against the zip.

items.title: Zip includes tooling or secrets
items.symptom: Package contains .git, node_modules, CI configs, or non-theme folders.
items.check: Run the Packaging gate end-to-end and re-zip from a clean theme-only tree.

items.title: Broken empty or edge states
items.symptom: Layouts collapse on empty collection, long titles, sold-out, or 0/1/many variants.
items.check: Run the Development Checklist page packs that match the failed templates.

items.title: Forms lack real labels
items.check: Every input needs a visible or programmatically associated label; placeholders are not labels.
